name: surface-view-path-place-regions
description: A view declares its composition, and the region queries that start while a place that leaves the view out runs send no call to the host after the place released the view.
reason: The view calls reach the page as the notice view-call of a view that the host runs in a window, which the Go producer does not run (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
